# Security policy

Thanks for helping keep NALIDE Check and the people who use it safe.

## Reporting a security issue

Please report it privately, either:

- Open a [security advisory](https://github.com/fengderenzhui-lab/web-check/security/advisories/new) here on GitHub
- Or email `contact@nalide.com`

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Please don't share an unfixed issue publicly until we've had 30 days to fix it.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release is supported with security updates.
